name: 2020-1c-parcial2-tema1
title: Warehouse robots – cleaning trailers and product shipping (Tema 1)
description: Starting from the first-midterm warehouse model (robots, products, trailers, cashier), the student must add smart trailers with pluggable cleaners (bleach sprayer skipping type A products, UV emitter) without modifying the Trailer class, and model shipping a robot's trailer through a distribution center that picks a cargo vehicle by destination, arrival time (via a simulated external travel-time service) and weight capacity, using a configurable selection criterion (lightest vehicle or last to arrive).

design.notes: Open/closed pressure everywhere: Trailer cannot be modified so cleaners need a decorator or wrapper plus double dispatch on the product kind, the selection criterion must be a swappable strategy object, and the vehicle choice is a select:/detect:/inject: pipeline over heterogeneous vehicles whose travel times come from a simulated external service.
